hook: Small bedroom version of the $59 hack: $85 total

scenes.visual_prompt: Small, narrow bedroom with a compact window and tight wall space around the bed
scenes.voiceover: Small bedrooms usually come with small windows, and that changes the math on this whole trick.

scenes.visual_prompt: Visual comparison graphic of 84-inch drapery overwhelming a 40-inch window frame
scenes.on_screen_text: Standard drapery overwhelms a small window
scenes.voiceover: Eighty-four-inch drapery sized for a standard window overwhelms a forty-inch one instead of flattering it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Product graphic of black 40x63 curtain panels with overlay showing 4.5 stars, 6,578 ratings, $9.98
scenes.voiceover: Scale the drapery down with the room — this set is built for exactly the smaller window, nine ninety-eight for the pair.

scenes.visual_prompt: A reduced 3-tile panel set on a small wall with only one floating shelf instead of a full three-shelf set
scenes.voiceover: Drop to a single shelf instead of the full three-shelf set if wall space is tight.

scenes.visual_prompt: Full styled small-room shot: panel wall, pillow stack, scaled curtains, and one shelf
scenes.voiceover: Panel set, the smaller curtains, and one shelf keeps the whole look under eighty-five dollars total.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final wide shot of the small bedroom looking open and styled rather than cramped
scenes.voiceover: The trick doesn't get skipped in a small room — it just gets sized to fit it.

caption: I sized this hack down for anyone whose bedroom is under 120 square feet, because the full-size version actually makes a small room look smaller. Full list on the blog.
